mapper.select: WITH days AS ( SELECT (#{ctx.today}::date + n)::date AS business_date FROM generate_series(0, #{ctx.today}::date - #{ctx.today}::date) AS n ), habit_days AS ( SELECT d.business_date,h.id AS habit_id,h.status,h.deleted_at, CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN c.revision_id ELSE r.id END AS revision_id, CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN c.category_id ELSE r.category_id END AS category_id, CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN c.name ELSE r.name END AS name, CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN c.expected_time ELSE r.expected_time END AS expected_time, c.id AS checkin_id, CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS done_count, 1 AS due_count FROM habit h CROSS JOIN days d LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ci.id,ci.revision_id,cr.category_id,cr.name,cr.expected_time FROM habit_checkin ci JOIN habit_revision cr ON cr.id=ci.revision_id AND cr.habit_id=h.id AND cr.user_id=h.user_id WHERE ci.habit_id=h.id AND ci.user_id=h.user_id AND ci.business_date=d.business_date AND ci.cancelled_at IS NULL ) c ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT hr.id,hr.category_id,hr.name,hr.expected_time,hr.status_snapshot,hr.deleted_snapshot, hr.start_date,hr.weekday_mask FROM habit_revision hr WHERE hr.habit_id=h.id AND hr.user_id=h.user_id AND hr.effective_date<=d.business_date ORDER BY hr.effective_date DESC,hr.revision_no DESC LIMIT 1 ) r ON true WHERE h.user_id=#{ctx.userId} AND ( c.id IS NOT NULL OR (r.status_snapshot='ACTIVE' AND NOT r.deleted_snapshot AND r.start_date<=d.business_date AND (r.weekday_mask::integer & (1 << (EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM d.business_date)::integer-1)))<>0) ) ), plan_counts AS ( SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.plan_date=#{ctx.today}) AS today_tasks, count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.plan_date=#{ctx.today} AND t.status='COMPLETED') AS today_current_completed_tasks, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.daily_plan_id IS NULL) AS week_undated_tasks FROM task_assignment a JOIN task t ON t.id=a.task_id AND t.user_id=a.user_id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN stage s ON s.id=t.stage_id AND s.user_id=a.user_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN goal g ON g.id=s.goal_id AND g.user_id=a.user_id AND g.deleted_at IS NULL AND g.archived_at IS NULL JOIN weekly_plan w ON w.id=a.weekly_plan_id AND w.user_id=a.user_id AND w.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN daily_plan d ON d.id=a.daily_plan_id AND d.user_id=a.user_id AND d.weekly_plan_id=w.id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE a.user_id=#{ctx.userId} AND a.ended_at IS NULL AND w.week_start_date=date_trunc('week',#{ctx.today}::timestamp)::date AND (a.daily_plan_id IS NULL OR d.plan_date=#{ctx.today}) ), execution_today AS ( SELECT floor(COALESCE(sum(GREATEST(0,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ( LEAST(LEAST(#{ctx.now},COALESCE(sg.ended_at,LEAST(#{ctx.now},es.last_heartbeat_at+make_interval(secs=>sg.heartbeat_timeout_seconds),sg.eligible_until))), (#{ctx.today}+1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE #{ctx.timeZone}) -GREATEST(sg.started_at,#{ctx.today}::timestamp AT TIME ZONE #{ctx.timeZone})))*1000)),0)/1000)::bigint AS actual_seconds FROM execution_session es JOIN execution_segment sg ON sg.execution_id=es.id WHERE es.user_id=#{ctx.userId} ), habit_counts AS ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(done_count),0)::bigint AS habit_done,COALESCE(sum(due_count),0)::bigint AS habit_due FROM habit_days ) SELECT p.*,e.actual_seconds,h.habit_done,h.habit_due, round(100.0*h.habit_done/NULLIF(h.habit_due,0),2) AS habit_completion_rate, (SELECT id::text FROM execution_session WHERE user_id=#{ctx.userId} AND status='RUNNING') AS running_execution_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM notification_message WHERE user_id=#{ctx.userId} AND read_at IS NULL AND handle_status<>'INVALIDATED') AS unread_messages FROM plan_counts p CROSS JOIN execution_today e CROSS JOIN habit_counts h

SELECT e.id::text,e.task_id::text,t.name AS task_name,e.version,s.id::text AS segment_id, floor(COALESCE(lengths.milliseconds,0)/1000)::bigint AS actual_seconds, (e.last_heartbeat_at+make_interval(secs=>s.heartbeat_timeout_seconds)) AS heartbeat_deadline, s.eligible_until,(e.controller_session_id=#{ctx.sessionId} AND #{ctx.now}<LEAST(s.eligible_until, e.last_heartbeat_at+make_interval(secs=>s.heartbeat_timeout_seconds))) AS can_heartbeat FROM execution_session e JOIN task t ON t.id=e.task_id AND t.user_id=e.user_id JOIN execution_segment s ON s.execution_id=e.id AND s.ended_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT sum(GREATEST(0,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (LEAST(#{ctx.now},COALESCE(x.ended_at,LEAST(#{ctx.now},e.last_heartbeat_at +make_interval(secs=>x.heartbeat_timeout_seconds),x.eligible_until)))-x.started_at))*1000)) AS milliseconds FROM execution_segment x WHERE x.execution_id=e.id ) lengths ON true WHERE e.user_id=#{ctx.userId} AND e.status='RUNNING'

SELECT t.id::text AS task_id,t.name,t.status,t.version,g.id::text AS goal_id,s.id::text AS stage_id, a.id::text AS assignment_id,d.plan_date,CASE WHEN d.id IS NULL THEN 'WEEK_UNDATED' ELSE 'TODAY' END AS section, t.priority,t.due_date,a.sort_order FROM task_assignment a JOIN task t ON t.id=a.task_id AND t.user_id=a.user_id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN stage s ON s.id=t.stage_id AND s.user_id=a.user_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN goal g ON g.id=s.goal_id AND g.user_id=a.user_id AND g.deleted_at IS NULL AND g.archived_at IS NULL JOIN weekly_plan w ON w.id=a.weekly_plan_id AND w.user_id=a.user_id AND w.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN daily_plan d ON d.id=a.daily_plan_id AND d.user_id=a.user_id AND d.weekly_plan_id=w.id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE a.user_id=#{ctx.userId} AND a.ended_at IS NULL AND w.week_start_date=date_trunc('week',#{ctx.today}::timestamp)::date AND ((a.daily_plan_id IS NULL) OR d.plan_date=#{ctx.today}) AND (#{section}::varchar IS NULL OR (#{section}='TODAY' AND d.plan_date=#{ctx.today}) OR (#{section}='WEEK_UNDATED' AND a.daily_plan_id IS NULL)) ORDER BY section,a.sort_order,a.id LIMIT LEAST(100,GREATEST(1,#{size})) OFFSET GREATEST(0,#{offset})

SELECT count(*) FROM(SELECT t.id::text AS task_id,t.name,t.status,t.version,g.id::text AS goal_id,s.id::text AS stage_id, a.id::text AS assignment_id,d.plan_date,CASE WHEN d.id IS NULL THEN 'WEEK_UNDATED' ELSE 'TODAY' END AS section, t.priority,t.due_date,a.sort_order FROM task_assignment a JOIN task t ON t.id=a.task_id AND t.user_id=a.user_id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN stage s ON s.id=t.stage_id AND s.user_id=a.user_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN goal g ON g.id=s.goal_id AND g.user_id=a.user_id AND g.deleted_at IS NULL AND g.archived_at IS NULL JOIN weekly_plan w ON w.id=a.weekly_plan_id AND w.user_id=a.user_id AND w.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN daily_plan d ON d.id=a.daily_plan_id AND d.user_id=a.user_id AND d.weekly_plan_id=w.id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE a.user_id=#{ctx.userId} AND a.ended_at IS NULL AND w.week_start_date=date_trunc('week',#{ctx.today}::timestamp)::date AND ((a.daily_plan_id IS NULL) OR d.plan_date=#{ctx.today}) AND (#{section}::varchar IS NULL OR (#{section}='TODAY' AND d.plan_date=#{ctx.today}) OR (#{section}='WEEK_UNDATED' AND a.daily_plan_id IS NULL))) counted

WITH task_totals AS ( SELECT s.goal_id,count(*) AS task_count,count(*) FILTER(WHERE t.status='COMPLETED') AS completed_tasks, sum(t.weight::numeric) AS total_weight,COALESCE(sum(t.weight::numeric) FILTER(WHERE t.status='COMPLETED'),0) AS completed_weight FROM stage s JOIN task t ON t.stage_id=s.id AND t.user_id=s.user_id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE s.user_id=#{ctx.userId} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY s.goal_id ) SELECT g.id::text,g.name,g.status,g.version,g.completion_condition_met, COALESCE(tt.task_count,0) AS task_count,COALESCE(tt.completed_tasks,0) AS completed_tasks, round(100.0*tt.completed_weight/NULLIF(tt.total_weight,0),2) AS current_progress FROM goal g LEFT JOIN task_totals tt ON tt.goal_id=g.id WHERE g.user_id=#{ctx.userId} AND g.deleted_at IS NULL AND g.archived_at IS NULL ORDER BY g.created_at DESC,g.id DESC LIMIT LEAST(100,GREATEST(1,#{size})) OFFSET GREATEST(0,#{offset})

SELECT count(*) FROM(WITH task_totals AS ( SELECT s.goal_id,count(*) AS task_count,count(*) FILTER(WHERE t.status='COMPLETED') AS completed_tasks, sum(t.weight::numeric) AS total_weight,COALESCE(sum(t.weight::numeric) FILTER(WHERE t.status='COMPLETED'),0) AS completed_weight FROM stage s JOIN task t ON t.stage_id=s.id AND t.user_id=s.user_id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE s.user_id=#{ctx.userId} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY s.goal_id ) SELECT g.id::text,g.name,g.status,g.version,g.completion_condition_met, COALESCE(tt.task_count,0) AS task_count,COALESCE(tt.completed_tasks,0) AS completed_tasks, round(100.0*tt.completed_weight/NULLIF(tt.total_weight,0),2) AS current_progress FROM goal g LEFT JOIN task_totals tt ON tt.goal_id=g.id WHERE g.user_id=#{ctx.userId} AND g.deleted_at IS NULL AND g.archived_at IS NULL) counted

WITH days AS ( SELECT (#{ctx.today}::date + n)::date AS business_date FROM generate_series(0, #{ctx.today}::date - #{ctx.today}::date) AS n ), habit_days AS ( SELECT d.business_date,h.id AS habit_id,h.status,h.deleted_at,h.history_locked_through, CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN c.revision_id ELSE r.id END AS revision_id, CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN c.category_id ELSE r.category_id END AS category_id, CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN c.name ELSE r.name END AS name, CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN c.expected_time ELSE r.expected_time END AS expected_time, c.id AS checkin_id, CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS done_count, 1 AS due_count FROM habit h CROSS JOIN days d LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ci.id,ci.revision_id,cr.category_id,cr.name,cr.expected_time FROM habit_checkin ci JOIN habit_revision cr ON cr.id=ci.revision_id AND cr.habit_id=h.id AND cr.user_id=h.user_id WHERE ci.habit_id=h.id AND ci.user_id=h.user_id AND ci.business_date=d.business_date AND ci.cancelled_at IS NULL ) c ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT hr.id,hr.category_id,hr.name,hr.expected_time,hr.status_snapshot,hr.deleted_snapshot, hr.start_date,hr.weekday_mask FROM habit_revision hr WHERE hr.habit_id=h.id AND hr.user_id=h.user_id AND hr.effective_date<=d.business_date ORDER BY hr.effective_date DESC,hr.revision_no DESC LIMIT 1 ) r ON true WHERE h.user_id=#{ctx.userId} AND ( c.id IS NOT NULL OR (r.status_snapshot='ACTIVE' AND NOT r.deleted_snapshot AND r.start_date<=d.business_date AND (r.weekday_mask::integer & (1 << (EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM d.business_date)::integer-1)))<>0) ) ) SELECT habit_id::text,revision_id::text,category_id::text,name,expected_time,status,deleted_at,checkin_id::text, done_count,due_count,(checkin_id IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (history_locked_through IS NULL OR history_locked_through<#{ctx.today})) AS can_cancel, (checkin_id IS NULL AND status='ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (history_locked_through IS NULL OR history_locked_through<#{ctx.today})) AS can_checkin FROM habit_days ORDER BY expected_time NULLS LAST,habit_id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
